title: Tool Capability Maintenance Phase 2 Roadmap
goal: Make Odysseus' maintenance AI keep tool usage knowledge, tool index state, Memory chunks, and RaptorGraph tool-capability facts fresh after every update, without storing private content or relying on UI work.

phase1_summary: Post-update hook refreshes the runtime ToolIndex after a successful deploy and Chroma health check.
A redacted tool capability snapshot is generated under data/tool_capability_knowledge.
Memory-record-shaped chunks and a RaptorGraph event are generated from trusted registry metadata.
Agent/chat context injects current tool capability knowledge for capability/tool/file/git questions.
current_baseline.known_local_gap: A full local ToolIndex refresh cannot be proven on the Windows workstation when ChromaDB is not listening on localhost:8100; Debian updater runs this after Chroma readiness.

slice_queue.goal: Confirm latest local branch, fuzzy/dev, Debian version, Chroma readiness, and current data/tool_capability_knowledge state before changing anything.
slice_queue.done_when: Preflight report identifies whether Phase 1 is deployed and whether live ToolIndex refresh can run on Debian.
evidence: git log shows cf4193c2 as current local HEAD.
refresh_tool_capability_knowledge.py --reason preflight --commit cf4193c2 --skip-index --no-persist returned status=refreshed, builtin_tool_count=79, memory_records=10, raptorgraph_event=true.
Both roadmap JSON files validate with python -m json.tool.

slice_queue.goal: Run a bounded Debian smoke proving that the post-update hook can refresh ToolIndex and persist latest.json/history.jsonl after services are ready.
slice_queue.done_when: Debian latest.json exists, history.jsonl appended one row, ToolIndex status is ok, and no secret/path leak appears in output.

slice_queue.goal: Add a policy-aware executor path that can write generated tool capability memory records into the native Memory vector store when system-memory writes are explicitly allowed.
slice_queue.done_when: Tool capability memory records can be written idempotently, vector-indexed, provenance-logged, and skipped safely when the write gate is closed.
evidence: execute_tool_capability_memory_write blocks when write_gate_open=false.
Dry-run mode plans writes without touching Memory or Chroma.
Live execution path upserts by stable memory_id, preserves idempotence, updates MemoryVectorStore when provided, and records memory_maintenance provenance.
CLI supports --write-memory plus --dry-run-memory-write and ODYSSEUS_TOOL_CAPABILITY_MEMORY_WRITE for gated update integration.
Focused suite passed: tests/test_tool_capability_maintenance.py tests/test_homeserver_auto_update_timer.py tests/test_context_orchestrator.py tests/test_memory_provenance_ledger.py -> 26 passed.

slice_queue.goal: Route tool capability RaptorGraph events into the graph/event store or an equivalent redacted maintenance ledger so graph memory can link tool facts to update commits.
slice_queue.done_when: A tool capability refresh can create or dedupe a graph event with snapshot id, commit, memory record ids, and no raw private data.
evidence: append_tool_capability_raptorgraph_event writes redacted JSONL events under data/tool_capability_raptorgraph.
normalize_tool_capability_raptorgraph_event derives stable tool-rg event ids from source_fingerprint plus memory_record_ids.
Duplicate append returns duplicate without writing a second row.
RaptorGraph appends record redacted raptorgraph_mutation provenance.
CLI supports --write-raptorgraph plus --dry-run-raptorgraph-write and ODYSSEUS_TOOL_CAPABILITY_RAPTOR_WRITE for gated update integration.
Focused suite passed: tests/test_tool_capability_maintenance.py tests/test_homeserver_auto_update_timer.py tests/test_context_orchestrator.py tests/test_memory_provenance_ledger.py -> 27 passed.

slice_queue.goal: Prevent stale capability answers by adding a small self-report guard: if the user asks what Odysseus can do, the answer must be grounded in the current tool capability provider payload.
slice_queue.done_when: Regression tests prove capability questions receive tool capability context and mention current tools such as read_file, write_file, grep, bash, python, and manage_repos when available.

slice_queue.goal: Expose a backend diagnostics readback for the latest tool capability snapshot, index status, memory write status, and RaptorGraph event status.
slice_queue.done_when: A read-only API or existing diagnostics path can report latest snapshot id, timestamp, commit, index status, chunk count, and graph event id without UI changes.
evidence: read_tool_capability_diagnostics returns latest snapshot id, generated_at, commit, index_status, domain counts, memory record ids/count, and RaptorGraph event/readback status.
GET /api/diagnostics/tool-capabilities is admin-gated and redacted.
No UI files were changed for this slice.

Focused suite passed: tests/test_tool_capability_diagnostics.py tests/test_tool_capability_maintenance.py tests/test_homeserver_auto_update_timer.py tests/test_context_orchestrator.py tests/test_memory_provenance_ledger.py -> 29 passed.

slice_queue.goal: Add focused regression coverage that the updater script calls the refresh hook after service readiness and that script failures are visible.
slice_queue.done_when: Focused tests or static assertions prove the update wrapper invokes the refresh after Chroma wait and before scheduled update completion.
evidence: tests/test_homeserver_auto_update_timer.py asserts the refresh command runs after App/Chroma readiness and version verification, before scheduled update completion.
Focused suite passed: tests/test_homeserver_auto_update_timer.py tests/test_tool_capability_maintenance.py tests/test_context_orchestrator.py -> 18 passed.

slice_queue.goal: After repo tests pass and the feature is pushed, deploy to Debian and ask Odysseus via Telegram or chat what tools it has, verifying the answer is no longer stale.
slice_queue.done_when: Odysseus correctly reports current file, shell, grep/glob/ls, repo, memory, and sandbox-related capabilities or clearly states which are gated/disabled.

global_acceptance: Every update refreshes the runtime ToolIndex.
Every update emits a redacted tool capability snapshot.
Tool usage Memory chunks are generated and, when the write gate is open, written idempotently.
RaptorGraph receives a source-linked tool capability event or a clear blocked status.
Odysseus no longer says core tools are missing when they are present but gated.
No private content, secrets, chat ids, tokens, or absolute host paths are persisted.
